name: Delete an organization migration archive
description: Delete an organization migration archive Deletes a previous migration archive. DELETE /orgs/{org}/migrations/{migration_id}/archive
context:
DELETE /orgs/{org}/migrations/{migration_id}/archive
Deletes a previous migration archive. Migration archives are automatically deleted after seven days.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.; migration_id (path) — The unique identifier of the migration.

name: Download an organization migration archive
description: Download an organization migration archive Fetches the URL to a migration archive. GET /orgs/{org}/migrations/{migration_id}/archive
context:
GET /orgs/{org}/migrations/{migration_id}/archive
Fetches the URL to a migration archive.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.; migration_id (path) — The unique identifier of the migration.

name: Get an organization migration status
description: Get an organization migration status Fetches the status of a migration. GET /orgs/{org}/migrations/{migration_id}
context:
GET /orgs/{org}/migrations/{migration_id}
Fetches the status of a migration. The `state` of a migration can be one of the following values: * `pending`, which means the migration hasn't started yet. * `exporting`, which means the migration is in progress. * `exported`, which means the migration finished successfully. * `failed`, which means the migration failed.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.; migration_id (path) — The unique identifier of the migration.
Optional: exclude (query) — Exclude attributes from the API response to improve performance

name: List organization migrations
description: List organization migrations Lists the most recent migrations, including both exports (which can be started through the REST API) and imports (which cannot be started using the REST API). GET /orgs/{org}/migrations
context:
GET /orgs/{org}/migrations
Lists the most recent migrations, including both exports (which can be started through the REST API) and imports (which cannot be started using the REST API). A list of `repositories` is only returned for export migrations.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.
Optional: per_page (query) — The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."; page (query) — The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."; exclude (query) — Exclude attributes from the API response to improve performance

name: Unlock an organization repository
description: Unlock an organization repository Unlocks a repository that was locked for migration. DELETE /orgs/{org}/migrations/{migration_id}/repos/{repo_name}/lock
context:
DELETE /orgs/{org}/migrations/{migration_id}/repos/{repo_name}/lock
Unlocks a repository that was locked for migration. You should unlock each migrated repository and [delete them](https://docs.github.com/rest/repos/repos#delete-a-repository) when the migration is complete and you no longer need the source data.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.; migration_id (path) — The unique identifier of the migration.; repo_name (path) — repo_name parameter
